reference_sql:
WITH web AS (SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n_web_orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY CAST(order_ts AS DATE)),
chk AS (SELECT CAST(observed_ts AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n_checks FROM competitor_prices WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY CAST(observed_ts AS DATE))
SELECT COALESCE(w.d, k.d) AS day, COALESCE(w.n_web_orders, 0) AS n_web_orders, COALESCE(k.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM web w
FULL OUTER JOIN chk k ON k.d = w.d

solver.query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS n_web_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE channel = 'web'
    AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
), k AS (
  SELECT CAST(observed_ts AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS n_checks
  FROM competitor_prices
  WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(w.day, k.day) AS day, COALESCE(w.n_web_orders, 0) AS n_web_orders, COALESCE(k.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM w
FULL OUTER JOIN k ON k.day = w.day
